01
Concept

A specialty coffee house with Emirati roots

We picked Ritual because we could visit it and compare the visit with its Instagram. Here is what we found, side by side.

What Instagram shows

Products and spaces, beautifully filmed. No price, no branch, no reason to choose.

vs

What our visit found

Lively, warm, full of students and friends. The real café beats its feed.

Position · hypothesis

Everyday premium, Emirati identity

Only Ritual combines a drive-thru with cultural campaigns in our scan. The account never says it. That silence is the opportunity.

Brand personality

Sincerity first

Warm, welcoming, generous. Eid and Eidiya come before the premium look, and the visit proves it.

Value

A place to stay

Quality coffee, breakfast, seats to study or meet, quick service, long hours from 7 AM. Time and place utility in four branches.

04
The Gap

Unclear social media positioning

The core gap · stated in our mid-term

Positioning issue

Ritual showcases its coffee, food and atmosphere, but the social media does not say what sets it apart from competing cafés in Al Ain. Everything below is a symptom of that one issue: a post that never says "choose Ritual because" cannot give a price, a reason or a call to action.

Strong1. Problem recognitionEid, cake and heritage posts spark interest and cravings.
GAP2. Information searchNo price, branch, hours or offer terms anywhere.
GAP3. EvaluationNothing says why Ritual over any other café.
GAP4. ChoiceAlmost no calls to action. The feed never closes.
Opening5. Post-purchaseGroup check: zero replies from Ritual on the analysed posts. Reply, reshare, reward.

SStrengths

  • Modern, calm, cosy (observed)
  • Friendly staff, quick service
  • Attractive presentation

WWeaknesses

  • Unclear difference vs. other cafés
  • Inconsistent calls to action
  • Instagram flatter than the visit

OOpportunities

  • Show the full experience
  • Voice the Emirati identity
  • Visit-focused calls to action

TThreats

  • Rivals offer similar spaces
  • Visuals can be copied
  • Convenience and habit win
Next: how we close this gap →
05
Strategy

From likes to visits: three moves

Target: students and friend groups. Position: everyday premium with Emirati identity. Growth logic: market penetration, more visits from the customers we already reach.

Content

Every promotion states what, which branch, until when. Heritage posts end with an invitation. Experience posts show the lively café.

Platforms

Instagram stays primary. Bio and highlights carry branch names and hours. TikTok (11.3M UAE users 18+) is the test channel.

Engagement

Reply to every comment, reshare customer visits, test student creators as opinion leaders. Comments are the KPI.

Measure

Baseline: 29K followers · 676 likes · 15 comments · 418 shares · 108 saves per post. Track comments-per-like and visits via the bio link.

The 4 P's of the plan, the marketing mix

Product

The lecture calls a product a bundle of benefits. Ritual's bundle is the drink, the corner seat, the plug, the drive-thru. Our plan sells the whole bundle in every post, not just the cup.

Price

Price is the assignment of value: what the customer exchanges to receive the offering. Today the feed hides it, so value cannot be judged. We state prices and use day-hour student offers as a discount tactic.

Place

Four own branches plus drive-thru is a direct channel, full control of the experience. It delivers time, place and possession utility: open from 7 AM, near campus, order to the car in 90 seconds.

Promotion

The feed must communicate the offering: what it is, which branch, how much, until when. Every post ends with a call to action, and the bio link closes the path from seeing to ordering.

Objectives, SMART format, your numbers

  • Raise comments per 100 likes from 2.2 to [target] by [date]
  • Call to action + branch + terms in 100% of promotional posts from [date]
  • Reply to every comment within [X hours]
  • Drive [N] tracked visits per month through the bio link

1. Show the square

Own the empty corner of the map: everyday premium plus Emirati identity, said out loud in every bio, highlight and caption.

2. Close the loop

Every post ends the journey: branch, price, hours, "Plan your visit". The feed becomes a booking tool.

3. Start the conversation

Turn 2,078 shares into replies and visits: question stickers, comment prompts, staff answering.

Next: doing this responsibly →
07
CSR

Marketing a café responsibly

Five commitments that also fix weaknesses found in the analysis.

Honest offers

Clear terms, dates and prices on every promotion. This fixes the unclear Eidiya details.

Genuine culture

Campaign content reflects real values, with real people who agreed to appear.

Handling feedback

One Tripadvisor reviewer said a complaint was not taken seriously. Commit to public, polite replies that fix the issue.

Protecting young people

The UAE announced a social media ban for under-15s on 18 June 2026. We never target that group.

Privacy

Ask permission before reposting any customer photo, and credit them.

Course concepts used in this plan

Ch. 1 value proposition, utility (time and place), triple bottom line · Ch. 3 situation analysis, SWOT, SMART objectives, ROMI, market penetration · Ch. 6 consumer decision journey, perception, psychographics (AIO), opinion leaders, reference groups · Ch. 7 segmentation, targeting, positioning decision, brand personality, perceptual map · Ch. 8 & 9 specialty product classification, product experience layers, product life cycle · Ch. 10 pricing objectives and tactics · Ch. 11 distribution (drive-thru as direct channel, place utility)
